Step 3 requires replacing mutable approved-plan/live-checkpoint references, but step 5 says to update only coverage/result/progress references. Specify whether to create versioned assessment/validation copies or update every dependent record, and require recursive validation of nested references and hashes.

Add an ID-to-path-to-locator/quote mapping for MC22, MC23, MC28–MC33, MC35, G8 and the top-level assessment, with a rule that each replacement must support the stated claim. Include the required PDF page/section anchor for MC32.

The latest review also found overclaiming of complete-audit scope. The plan should explicitly require result.md and progress.md to retract completion language and describe this invocation as bounded reference/provenance repair pending substantive reconciliation and profile comparison.

Current assessments are not consistently reconciled with historical evidence. MC25 says transactional storage and migrations remain unimplemented, contradicting P07's code, tests and the audit's own historical register. G18 similarly leaves canonicalization and migration demonstration undifferentiated from already demonstrated bounded behavior. Revise affected rows to identify what exists, its limits, and the precise remaining proposal obligation.

Evidence locators need repair. MC22 points to nonexistent /insurance rather than /insurer. MC28–MC31, MC33 and the top-level assessment reference use JSON Pointer /, which selects an empty-name property rather than the document root. MC32 cites text lines in a PDF; MC35 cites lines 1–80 of a shorter file. Replace these with valid, claim-specific anchors and independently resolve them.

Several valid-looking anchors do not support their assessments: MC23 cites a loan contractID for frontend comparison, while G8 cites reconstruction/execution text for literature-screening conclusions. Audit the new rows against actual supporting passages and results. Replace the repeated generic remaining-work sentence in 15 gap rows with specific outstanding design obligations.

Completion reporting exceeds the approved scope. The approved plan required reviewing eight existing assessments without adding assessments; the worker added the full matrix and declared completion. replacement_support.claim_fragment: One representation, several authoring methods

reference.quote:
A document extractor, a human editor, a Python library and the
AccDSL compiler all create the same records.

replacement_support.supporting_excerpt:
\section{One representation, several authoring methods}

The architectural centre is a typed intermediate representation (IR), not a
text parser. A document extractor, a human editor, a Python library and the
AccDSL compiler all create the same records. This allows a modeller to begin
with a reviewed structured file and later add convenient notation. It also
allows source extraction to improve without changing accounting semantics.

replacement_support.claim_fragment: Why a DSL, and when another approach is better

reference.quote:
The strongest baseline is a typed schema, SQL storage and ordinary Python
code.

replacement_support.supporting_excerpt:
\section{Why a DSL, and when another approach is better}

The strongest baseline is a typed schema, SQL storage and ordinary Python
code. That combination can implement the whole product. Its disadvantage is
that repeated accounting requirements can become conventions scattered across
functions: implicit currency conversion, missing period checks, hidden default
values and duplicated rule selection. A bounded language makes these
requirements part of typing and compilation. Its costs are language
maintenance, diagnostics, migration and training.
